title: World A — Gray-box Street (placeholder)
description: A short city block at night, gray-box placeholder geometry. A wet two-lane street runs north to south between tall building masses. Neon signage glows on the facades. An alley mouth opens on the west side, halfway along the block, and dead-ends at a single lit doorway. Placeholder geometry only — no story canon.
worldTexture: placeholder location — not tied to any story canon
neon signage: green constant plus one accent colour
no vehicles, no people — the block is empty

triggers.label: The Alley Mouth
triggers.srHint: The alley opens to the west.

triggers.label: The Doorway
triggers.prompt: Press E to open the door
triggers.srHint: A single lit doorway at the dead end of the alley.

triggers.label: The Neon Sign
triggers.prompt: Press E to read the sign
triggers.srHint: A buzzing neon sign hangs low over the east sidewalk.

trigger.text: The sign has lost half its letters to the weather. What is left of it still buzzes, throwing green across the wet pavement in a slow, uneven pulse.

triggers.label: The Plaza Door
triggers.prompt: Press E to step through to the plaza
triggers.srHint: A service door in the east wall, standing open on somewhere brighter.
